mapper.sql: select config_id, config_key, config_value, config_name, remark, create_time, update_time from doupi_cms_config
mapper.insert: insert into doupi_cms_config (config_key, config_value, config_name, remark, create_time) values (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configName}, #{remark}, sysdate())

insert into doupi_cms_config (config_key, config_value, config_name, update_time) values (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configName}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update config_value = values(config_value), config_name = values(config_name), update_time = sysdate()
